Notebook sugarR has 21 GRNs annotated left; one root is mapped by stable supervoxel to v783. The extra right stimulus has all 64 right LB3 GRNs, not a matched L/R design.

The audit was regenerated with deduplicated v1 roots and explicit token-inclusive literature annotations during the independent validation runs; no simulation parameters or thresholds were changed.
All primary statistics use 30 trials. The separate two-trial validations are not pooled into the primary rate estimates.
